data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 晨光羊毛毯间慵懒苏醒
data.action: 斜倚清晨被褥间以柔软羊毛毯半掩身姿回眸
data.lighting: 穿过薄纱窗帘的柔和淡金晨光
data.description: 淡金色的晨曦透过薄纱帘漫进卧房，薰衣草色长发散落在枕畔。尚未着衣的提弗洛斯慵懒地半撑起上身，柔软的浅色羊毛毯仅随意搭在腰际与腿间，露出温润圆滑的肩背与胸口轮廓。她揉了揉惺忪的粉紫眼眸，带着刚醒时的低哑笑意拉住你的手腕。
data.promptProse: Reclining lazily among sunlit white bedsheets with a soft wool blanket draped loosely across her hips, Typhoeus props herself up on one elbow, bare skin glowing in the pale morning light as she looks at the viewer with a tender, sleepy smile.
data.animaCaption: She rests naked among sunlit morning sheets with a blanket draped loosely at her hips, looking warmly at the viewer with a sleepy blush.
data.nsfwProse: Her unadorned upper body is bathed in warm morning sunlight with a soft blanket resting lightly across her lower hips.
